sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Flappy Dragons is a game about timing and reflexes. As you navigate your dragon through the levels, you'll need to tap the screen or press a button to make your dragon flap its wings and fly. The game's controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy to pick up, but its difficulty level increases exponentially as you progress through the levels. The game's physics engine is also surprisingly realistic, with your dragon's movements and reactions feeling incredibly responsive.

One of the game's most challenging features is its obstacle system. From towering trees to rocky outcroppings, the game's obstacles are designed to test your reflexes and timing. You'll need to time your taps perfectly to avoid crashing into these obstacles, and the game's increasing difficulty level will make it harder and harder to succeed. But don't worry, with practice, you'll soon be flying like a pro.

As you progress through the levels, you'll also encounter special power-ups and items that will help you on your journey. These power-ups can give you a temporary boost in speed, increase your dragon's health, or even grant you a temporary shield. With these power-ups, you'll be able to tackle even the toughest levels and obstacles with confidence.

Overall, Flappy Dragons' core gameplay mechanics are simple yet addictive, making it a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down.
